title: 第1216章 败退重伤第1215章 三重屏障
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
只见陆尘皮肤裂开。
肌肉被切开。
骨骼被斩断。
鲜血，从伤口中喷涌而出。
那血，是金紫色的。
因为他的血液中，融合了鸿蒙天魔的两种力量。
现在，这两种力量的血液，正在从他的体内喷涌而出。
每一滴血液，都蕴含着恐怖的能量。
但此刻，它们只能无力地洒落在空中。
噗！！！
鲜血飞溅。
陆尘的胸口，出现了一道从左肩到右肋的剑痕。
那道剑痕，又长又深。
深可见骨。
鲜血从伤口中狂涌而出。
陆尘的身体，如同流星般倒飞出去。
他的身体在空中划过一道弧线。
撞穿了一颗星辰。
那颗星辰直接四分五裂。
爆炸产生的光芒，照亮了半边天空。

陆尘的身体没有停下。
继续朝着后方飞去。
又撞穿了第二颗星辰。
第二颗星辰，是一颗恒星。
温度高达数十万度。
但陆尘的身体撞入恒星核心的时候。
恒星的核聚变反应直接被撞得紊乱。
恒星开始坍缩。
然后轰然爆炸。
第三颗。
第四颗。
第五颗。
……
陆尘一连撞穿了十几颗星辰。
才堪堪停下。
他的身体镶嵌在一颗巨大的陨石之中。
浑身是血。
胸口那道触目惊心的剑痕，还在往外涌着鲜血。
他的气息，虚弱到了极点。
content_en:
Lu Chen's skin was seen cracked.
The muscles are cut open.
The bones were chopped off.
Blood spurted out from the wound.
The blood is golden purple.
Because his blood is fused with the two powers of the Hongmeng Heavenly Demon.
Now, the blood of these two powers is spurting out of his body.
Every drop of blood contains terrifying energy.
But at this moment, they can only scatter feebly in the air.
puff! ! !
Blood splattered.
A sword mark appeared on Lu Chen's chest from his left shoulder to his right rib.
The sword mark was long and deep.
Deep bones are visible.
Blood gushes from the wound.
Lu Chen's body flew backwards like a meteor.
His body drew an arc in the air.
Crashed through a star.
The star immediately fell apart.
The light produced by the explosion lit up half of the sky.
Lu Chen's body did not stop.
Continue to fly towards the rear.
It crashed through the second star.
The second star is a star.
Temperatures reach hundreds of thousands of degrees.
But when Chase Lu's body crashed into the core of the star.
The star's nuclear fusion reaction was directly knocked into chaos.
The star begins to collapse.
Then it exploded.
The third one.
The fourth one.
The fifth one.
…
Lu Chen crashed through more than a dozen stars in a row.
Only then did he stop.
His body is embedded in a huge meteorite.
Covered in blood.
The shocking sword mark on his chest was still gushing blood.
His aura was extremely weak.
